brief:
Settlers attacked residential homes in Yasuf village, located east of Salfit in the northern West Bank, on Saturday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The assault targeted dwellings occupied by Palestinian residents in the community.

The nature and extent of damage to the homes remained unclear immediately following the incident. No casualty reports were released in the immediate aftermath of the attack. Yasuf has faced previous incidents involving settlers in the area surrounding Salfit governorate.
